SERVICE AGREEMENT

This agreement is made between the Provider and the Customer.

1. Definitions

In this agreement, "Service" means the hosted service described in Annex II.

2. Termination

2.1 Notice

Either party may terminate this agreement by written notice to the other party.

2.2 Termination for cause

Either party may terminate this agreement with immediate effect if the other
party commits a material breach of its obligations and fails to remedy that
breach within thirty (30) days of being notified of it in writing. Notice under
this clause must state the breach in reasonable detail. On termination the
Customer shall pay all fees due up to the date of termination, and the
Provider shall return or delete the Customer's data as the Customer instructs.

The notice must be given by one of the following means:

1. delivery by hand to the registered office;
2. registered post to the registered office;
3. email to the address named in Annex II.

Annex II

Service description and contact addresses.
